posthoc_geometry_sensitivity.status: Post hoc source-led sensitivity approved after independent challenge; not part of frozen analytic rule and not a new capacity measurement.
posthoc_geometry_sensitivity.profile_source: Christakis2010 fig.6.2, inspected by lead and challenger
assumptions: Approximate axisymmetry of the outer vessel envelope.
Outer maximum diameter D is no greater than the reported height H=53cm, based qualitatively on an undistorted published profile; no diameter was measured by the project.
The reported height adequately represents the complete original carrier and the source profile has no materially misleading distortion.
posthoc_geometry_sensitivity.formula: capacity <= external envelope cylinder = pi*H^3/4, using D<=H
posthoc_geometry_sensitivity.limitation: This conditional geometric bound is not a formal measurement uncertainty interval; wall thickness and taper only reduce internal capacity relative to the assumed envelope.

disclosure: Analytic rule frozen after KN34/117/17 were known, before ZA values and KN107 correction were received. This is source-led discovery, not preregistration over genuinely unused ancient evidence.
